_README: Philippine figures. PSA and the PSE publish no free API, so these are maintained here. The page flags a series that falls behind PSA's release dates.
Inflation lands ~the 5th of the following month; the Labour Force Survey ~the 8th.
Append the newest month to the END of each series. Charts keep the last 9 entries.

psei._note: Update after the PH close. 'prev' is the session before, used for the day move.
